label: PROVISIONAL floor model, measured on the classroom glossy tile floor on 2026-10-30 (one robot, one pack, 11.2-11.7 V). Not valid on other floors or below 11.2 V.

wheel.source: speed_vs_battery.json option a (k fixed at the Week 2 slope)

turn.left_right_note: not distinguishable: 12 right and 2 left pulses (0.2 s), 1 left + 1 right 0.4 s spin, 2 + 2 cross-board 0.8 s spins

startup.note: time from the drive command to the first range change in the received video = motor start + video latency (not separable)

video.note: the sim value 0.12 s is a choice inside the measured bounds (<= 0.153 s on the best pulse; frames still unchanged 0.06-0.17 s after a pulse start). One pulse (sup5 1.4 s) looks like frames 0.5-0.7 s stale at a run start: probable, not proven

drift.note: 0.45 = between the steady closed-loop mean 0.38 and the open-loop-from-rest mean; per-run spread is real, simulate it (e.g. normal, sd 0.12)

stop.rule: stop when range <= target + speed * 0.2 s (0.044 m at 0.22 m/s)
